title.narrative: Naturvårdsverket stöd till Ukrainas EU-medlemskap rörande avfallshantering
Swedish Environmental Protection Agency Ukraine EU accession on waste management

description.narrative: Projektet som ska genomföras av Naturvårdsverket syftar till att förbättra Ukrainas efterlevnad av EU Kapitel 27 och Minamata- och Stockholmskonventionerna, särskilt inom avfallshanteringsområdet. Detta kommer att uppnås genom ett tvådelat tillvägagångssätt: för det första genom att hjälpa miljöskyddsministeriet att hantera och förbereda EU-anslutningsprocessen i samband med kapitel 27 i EU:s regelverk om miljö, med fokus på avfall, och för det andra genom att stärka ministeriets förmåga att implementera lagstiftning genom effektiv policy och beslutsfattande, samt förbättra kommunikationen med avfallshanteringens intressenter.

The project to implemented by the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency seeks to enhance Ukraine's compliance with EU Chapter 27 and the Minamata and Stockholm conventions, particularly in the area of waste management. This will be achieved through a two­pronged approach: first, by aiding the Ministry of Environment Protection in managing and preparing for the EU accession process related to Chapter 27 of the EU Acquis on environment, with a focus on waste; and second, by bolstering the ministry's capacity to implement legislation through effective policy and decision­making, as well as improving communication with waste management stakeholders.

title.narrative: Grant Arrangement between Sida and Swedish Environmental Protection Agency on Ukraine 2024 - 2027

description.narrative:
The period between 19 September 2024 and 31 December 2024 was a start up phase for the project. The project provided substantial support to MEPNR on the EU accession component, developing Methodology for EU Accession and Methodology for Bilateral Screening pertaining to Chapter 27. The project established working relationships with the EU Integration department of the ministry, KEMI, EU Delegation, EU Commission and Umweltbundesamt Austria.
On the waste management side the project established the relationships with the relevant department and reform support team of MEPNR, although cooperation was hampered to some extent by the reorganization within the department and change of the leadership at the ministry. The project planned and organised a study visit to Sweden, in coordination with KEMI, SALAR International and Avfall Sverige. The project also established regular exchanges and coordination with EU-delegation, UNDP, Nefco and UBA (Austria), SALAR/Avfall Sverige, leading to improved coordination among partners in the sector.
